```{r}
library(sf)

```

```{r}
target_crs <- "EPSG:26913"
```

# Join Forest Tracker and Prior Wildfire into Treatment Dataset

## Load Forest Tracker 

This file is missing an assigned CRS and includes complex geometry types which are difficult to intersect, so this section also addresses those items. 

```{r}
#read file 
treats <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/CFTv2_FINAL_DATA.gdb", layer = "CFTv2_FinalData_20260220")

#Simplify and clean
treats <- treats %>%
  st_zm(drop=TRUE, what = "ZM") %>% #drop third and forth dimension
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>% #convert to simpler geometry 
  filter(MGT_TYPE != "Reforestation") %>%
  filter(!ACTIVITY %in% c("Pile Fuels", "Mastication", "Manual", "Mulching", "Mechanical", "Lop and Scatter", "Chemical")) %>%
  st_make_valid(treats) %>%
  rename("geometry" = "Shape")

#Add unique Id
treats$OBJECTID <- 1:nrow(treats)
treats <- treats %>% 
  mutate(OBJECTID = paste0("ForestTracker_", OBJECTID)) %>%
  mutate(OBJECTID = as.character(OBJECTID))
```

## Load MTBS to add Prior Wildfires

```{r}
#Load state boundary for cropping fire dataset
state_boundary <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/States/cb_2018_us_state_20m.shp") %>%
  st_transform(target_crs) %>% 
  filter(STUSPS == "CO")

# Using perimeter data for 1984-2024
allfires <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/mtbs_perimeter_data/mtbs_perims_DD.shp") %>%
  st_transform(target_crs) %>%
  mutate(Ig_Date = as.Date(Ig_Date), YEAR_COMP =year(Ig_Date)) %>%   # convert to date
  filter(Incid_Type=="Wildfire") %>%
  filter(YEAR_COMP >= 2000) %>%
  st_filter(state_boundary, .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  st_make_valid()

allfires <- allfires %>%
  rename(OBJECTID = Event_ID,
         MGT_TYPE = Incid_Type,
         EVENT_NAME = Incid_Name) %>%
  select("OBJECTID", "EVENT_NAME", "MGT_TYPE", "Ig_Date", "YEAR_COMP")
```

## Combine Forest Tracker and MTBS

```{r}
treats <- bind_rows(treats, allfires)
treats <- treats %>%
  dplyr::select("OBJECTID","MGT_TYPE", "ACTIVITY", "EVENT_NAME","YEAR_COMP")
```

# Overlap Subsequent Wildfire with Treatments

We will find which wildfires intersect with previous treatments, then filter both the fires and treats datasets to only the relevant items. We will then save the filtered datasets for mapping.

## Load Fresh MTBS Fire Perimeters 

I am filtering for fires from 2010 on. Perimeter data was pre-processed by HART lab.

```{r}
# Using perimeter data for 1984-2024
fires <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/mtbs_perimeter_data/mtbs_perims_DD.shp") %>% 
  st_transform(target_crs) %>% 
  mutate(Ig_Date = as.Date(Ig_Date), Fire_Year = year(Ig_Date)) %>%  
  filter(Fire_Year>=2010) %>%  
  filter(Incid_Type=="Wildfire") %>%
  filter(grepl("CO", Event_ID)) %>% 
  st_make_valid()
```

## Intersect Treatments and Subsequent Wildfires

```{r}
# Intersect treatments and subsequent wildfires
intersect <- st_intersection(treats, fires) %>%
  filter(YEAR_COMP < Fire_Year) %>% 
  dplyr::select("Event_ID", "Incid_Name", "Fire_Year", "OBJECTID", "EVENT_NAME","MGT_TYPE", "ACTIVITY", "YEAR_COMP")
```

## Subset Datasets

```{r}
# Subset Fires to only those that intersect with prior fuel treatments
fires <- fires %>% 
  filter(Event_ID %in% unique(intersect%>% pull(Event_ID))) %>%
  dplyr::select("Event_ID", "Incid_Name", "Ig_Date", "Fire_Year")
```

```{r}
# Subset treatments to only those that intersect subsequent wildfire 
treats <- treats %>% 
  filter(OBJECTID %in% unique(intersect%>% pull(OBJECTID)))
```

# Save Geopackage

```{r}
# Save the intersection result as the first layer
st_write(
  obj = intersect,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "intersection",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)

# Append the subsetted fires as a new layer
st_write(
  obj = fires,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "fires",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)

# Append the subsetted treatments as a new layer
st_write(
  obj = treats,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "treatments",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```
